title: 2025 JFK files release and Trump's answer on who killed Kennedy

tellings.quote: And even President Trump when he was asked point blank who killed JFK after the file drop he said we released the files we did a historic thing or whatever.

In accordance with President Donald Trump’s directive of March 17, 2025, all records previously withheld for classification that are part of the President John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Collection are released.
In an effort to maximize transparency, these records were released without redactions and some of these records contain the personal identification information of living individuals.

plain: In March 2025 the US government released its remaining secret files on the assassination of John F. Kennedy, and Michels points out that President Trump still would not say who did it. Michels tells it himself in an episode about Kennedy and UFOs. He says that when Trump "was asked point blank who killed JFK after the file drop", he answered only that "we released the files, we did a historic thing", or words to that effect. Michels raises it to suggest that the release did not settle the question. The release itself is on record. On March 18, 2025, the National Archives announced that "in accordance with President Donald Trump's directive of March 17, 2025, all records previously withheld for classification" in the Kennedy assassination collection "are released." It added that the records "were released without redactions" and that some held personal details of living people. Trump's answer comes only from Michels' telling.
